description: PostgreSQL: a parameter beside a column in COALESCE takes the column's type and may be NULL; = ANY($1) and <> ALL($1) take an array of the compared column's type; BETWEEN bounds are named after the column with _from and _to, a parameter passed to lower() compared with lower(column) after the column; NULLIF($1, '') compared with a column and NULLIF(id, $1) type and name the parameter from the other argument; a parameter that is a condition, an AND operand, a CASE condition or NOT's operand is boolean; INSERT without a column list types its values by position; pg_advisory_lock($1) takes the bigint its one-argument overload declares. Reported: an unknown INSERT target column, unknown names in subqueries and a CTE outside FROM, an unknown ON CONFLICT SET target, and a parameter used where text and where bigint is expected.
